title: Identification of immune-related genes and small-molecule drugs in hypertension-induced left ventricular hypertrophy based on machine learning algorithms and molecular docking.
authors: Zhou, Mingxuan; Li, Tiegang; Lv, Silin; Gan, Wenqiang; Zhang, Fang; Che, Yuexia; Yang, Liu; Hou, Yufang; Yan, Zheng; Zeng, Zifan; Zhao, Wenyi; Yang, Min
one_liner_zh: 该研究基于机器学习筛选高血压左心室肥厚免疫相关基因并做分子对接，虽涉及转录因子-mRNA网络，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法为基因表达分析而非AI/物理模拟结合机制研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) is a common consequence of hypertension and can lead to heart failure. The immune response plays an important role in hypertensive LVH; however, there is no comprehensive method to investigate the mechanistic relationships between immune response and hypertensive LVH or to find novel therapeutic targets. This study aimed to screen hub immune-related genes involved in hypertensive LVH as well as to explore immune target-based therapeutic drugs. MATERIALS AND METHODS: RNA-sequencing data from a mouse model generated by angiotensin II infusion were subjected to weighted gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA) to identify core expression modules. Machine learning algorithms were applied to screen immune-related LVH characteristic genes. Heart structures were evaluated by echocardiography and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMRI). Validation of hub genes was conducted by RT-qPCR and western blot. Using the Connectivity Map database and molecular docking, potential small-molecule drugs were explored. RESULTS: A total of 1215 differentially expressed genes were obtained, most of which were significantly enriched in immunoregulation and collagen synthesis. WGCNA and multiple machine learning strategies uncovered six hub immune-related genes (Ankrd1, Birc5, Nuf2, C1qtnf6, Fcgr3, and Cdca3) that may accurately predict hypertensive LVH diagnosis. Immune analysis revealed that fibroblasts and macrophages were closely correlated with hypertensive LVH, and hub gene expression was significantly associated with these immune cells. A regulatory network of transcription factor-mRNA and a ceRNA network of miRNA-lncRNA was established. Notably, six hub immune-related genes were significantly increased in the hypertensive LVH model, which were positively linked to left ventricle wall thickness. Finally, 12 small-molecule compounds with the potential to reverse the high expression of hub genes were ruled out as potential therapeutic agents for hypertensive LVH. CONCLUSION: This study identified and validated six hub immune-related genes that may play essential roles in hypertensive LVH, providing new insights into the potential pathogenesis of cardiac remodeling and novel targets for medical interventions.
abstract_zh: 背景：左心室肥厚（LVH）是高血压的常见后果，可导致心力衰竭。免疫反应在高血压性LVH中发挥重要作用；然而，目前尚无综合方法研究免疫反应与高血压性LVH之间的机制关系，或寻找新的治疗靶点。本研究旨在筛选参与高血压性LVH的核心免疫相关基因，并探索基于免疫靶点的治疗药物。材料与方法：对通过血管紧张素II输注生成的小鼠模型的RNA测序数据进行加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA），以识别核心表达模块。应用机器学习算法筛选免疫相关的LVH特征基因。通过超声心动图和心脏磁共振成像（CMRI）评估心脏结构。通过RT-qPCR和western blot验证核心基因。利用Connectivity Map数据库和分子对接，探索潜在的小分子药物。结果：共获得1215个差异表达基因，其中大多数显著富集于免疫调节和胶原合成。WGCNA和多种机器学习策略揭示了六个核心免疫相关基因（Ankrd1、Birc5、Nuf2、C1qtnf6、Fcgr3和Cdca3），可能准确预测高血压性LVH的诊断。免疫分析显示，成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞与高血压性LVH密切相关，核心基因表达与这些免疫细胞显著相关。建立了转录因子-mRNA调控网络和miRNA-lncRNA的ceRNA网络。值得注意的是，六个核心免疫相关基因在高血压性LVH模型中显著增加，并与左心室壁厚度正相关。最后，筛选出12种可能逆转核心基因高表达的小分子化合物，作为高血压性LVH的潜在治疗药物。结论：本研究识别并验证了六个可能在高血压性LVH中发挥重要作用的核心免疫相关基因，为心脏重塑的潜在发病机制提供了新见解，并为医学干预提供了新靶点。
